name: stira
description: Give each AI crew an immutable mission (IPD) and let it grow a living tree of mission-aligned knowledge distilled from its own work. Enable and go — no steering or hooks to hand-edit.
author: Resolver-TNG
highlights: Each crew gets an immutable core (IPD): its P0 mission, set once from the dashboard and hash-monitored for tampering
Knowledge is harvested from the crew's own sessions and distilled into scored leaves — a living tree per crew
The core is held constant so growth never drifts the mission; a tampered core trips an integrity breaker
A bundled skill teaches crews the library model: read the core and the index first, open only the leaves they need
Enable the app and go — background reflection crons ship disabled and off until you turn them on
useCases: Keep an autonomous crew aligned with a fixed mission while it accumulates reusable, mission-checked knowledge from experience.
configuration: Enable the app; Stira Forest appears in the sidebar. Define each crew's core (IPD) from the Forest page, then optionally turn on the reflection crons from its schedule panel.

crons.name: means-drift-reflection
crons.message: Run Stira means-drift reflection for every configured crew. Compare recent choices with each crew's immutable IPD mission, inventory impact scope, record only evidence-backed drift findings, and notify the human only when review or intervention is required. If no IPD is configured or nothing changed, produce no output.

crons.name: habituation-offset
crons.message: Run Stira habituation-offset reflection for every configured crew whose growth indicates increasing mastery. Re-inventory blast radius, assumptions, reversibility, approvals, and less-disproportionate alternatives against that crew's immutable IPD mission. Persist only reusable evidence-backed lessons and notify the human only when action is required. If no IPD is configured or nothing changed, produce no output.
